title: Firmwares
description: Install XPRS on a board, set it up and keep it updated.
summary: Plug a board into this phone or computer with a USB cable (a phone needs a USB OTG adapter). The app recognises the board, keeps the published XPRS firmwares on this device, installs the right one and checks it. A board flashed here is made yours over the same cable, and can get a callsign you choose. Stations nearby on WiFi or Bluetooth are listed too: see what firmware they run and how long, update yours over the air, put them on your WiFi, name them and read how they are doing. The WiFi password is sealed to the station's key.
